# run -match ^sends
>>> f.rr
-- sends only what it names --
GET {{url}}/a HTTP/1.1

-- and not this one --
get {{url}}/b HTTP/1.1

>>> want f.rr
-- sends only what it names --
GET {{url}}/a HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 2
Content-Type: text/plain

ok
-- and not this one --
get {{url}}/b HTTP/1.1
